elements.text: The Importance of Spending Money Wisely

Spending money is something we all do, whether it is for food, clothes or entertainment. However, it is important to spend money wisely. This means thinking carefully before buying something and making sure it is something you really need. When you spend money in a smart way, you can save more and a…

One of the first steps to spending money wisely is knowing the difference between needs and wants. Needs are things you must have, such as food, shelter and clothes. Wants are things you would like to have but can live without, like a new branded phone or expensive shoes. [27] This question can help…

Another good habit is making a budget. A budget is a plan that shows how much money you get and how much you can spend. When you make a budget, you can decide how much to spend on different things, like school supplies, food and fun activities. [28] A simple budget can help you stay organised and pr…

It is a good idea to learn how to handle money from a young age. [29] For example, giving children a small amount of pocket money can teach them how to manage their spending. When young people learn how to save and spend wisely early in life, they are more likely to become responsible adults.

Not spending money wisely can lead to many problems. [30] This can cause stress and even debt. For instance, if someone always buys new clothes but forgets to pay for school fees or food, they may end up in trouble. That is why it is important to think carefully before spending.

There are many ways to become a smart shopper. One tip is to compare prices before you buy something. [31] Another tip is to wait for sales or discounts. Buying during sales can help you save a lot of money. Also, try to pay with cash instead of a credit card, so you are more aware of how much you a…

Saving money is just as important as spending wisely. [32] You can save for future needs like school trips, gifts or emergencies. Having some money saved gives you peace of mind and more choices. You do not need to save a lot at once; even small amounts add up over time.

Sentence options: A. Parents and teachers can help children understand the value of money. B. Sometimes, the same item is cheaper in another shop or online. C. It also helps you to save a little money each month. D. One of the problems can be related to our mental health. E. Before you buy something…
Choose the best sentence for gap 31.
Sometimes, the same item is cheaper in another shop or online.
Parents and teachers can help children understand the value of money.
[AI-repaired 2026-04-22] Option B is the best choice as it directly relates to the advice of comparing prices before making a purchase, which aligns with the context of becoming a smart shopper.
